_source: Angel.vb. Screen units, per frame; flapRate and hurtDelay are seconds. rectWidth and rectBottom are the angel's hit rectangle (X..X+0.06 by Y+0.03..Y+angelSize/2), used by the heart. boundsX and boundsY are checkBounds' clamp on X and Y (left -0.6, right 0.5, bottom -0.6, top 0.4).

port._about: Not in the original; world units, never mapped. arenaBounds false (the default, U.CHN-T86) clamps the angel to checkBounds' boundsX/boundsY; true is the port's earlier choice, the level's arena inset by boundsMargin, kept only as a data option.
